name: CompBioBench v1
protocol: CompBioBench v1 fixed 100-task agent-system evaluation; Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude Code configurations remain system-level observations and are not treated as bare-model scores.

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of the fixed 100 tasks solved by the complete agent system. CLI scaffold, tool permissions, and model configuration are part of the protocol.
explanation.zh: 分数是完整 agent system 成功解决固定 100 个 task 的比例。CLI scaffold、tool permission 和 model configuration 都属于 protocol 的一部分。

summary.en: CompBioBench evaluates agent systems on multi-step computational-biology tasks requiring tools, code execution, and analysis.
summary.zh: CompBioBench 评估 agent system 完成需要工具、代码执行和分析的多步 computational biology task 的能力。

task_format.en: The agent works through 100 computational-biology tasks, using analysis tools and executable code before submitting a result.
task_format.zh: agent 需要完成 100 个 computational biology task，使用分析工具并执行代码后提交结果。
